discussion.body: Seris Vale. Main-side. Bengenia, Temple of Mist, Velith's blood without Velith's prayer. Joins Act 3. Death crises: stays behind in the wipe; or takes Velith's knife in the unmask if Cael/Liraen are boxed (they cannot die, so the knife can land on her). Default lives if she walks out with the party before the overdraw. Contingency: Veil Sigil from the ruin; Pale remnant NPC on a wreck-isle. If she dies and Bengenia is wiped, Mist has no living priest. That scars the ending fight (Veil is cracked) and does not change the ending thesis.
